purpose: Plan a prospective, independent, whole-game comparison only if the present evidence is insufficient for that claim.

execution_boundary.status_rule: Every future assignment and artifact remains PROPOSED_NOT_EXECUTED until explicit approval and a passed launch gate.

current_evidence_boundary.source_case_scope: one operator-assisted, read-only bilingual dashboard extension
current_evidence_boundary.observed_case_wall_meaning: Descriptive wall time for the prior case, including orchestration, auxiliary reviews, failed QA setup/control attempts and verification; not a new endpoint baseline, not pure inference latency, and not a productivity comparison.
current_evidence_boundary.identity_boundary: The prior runtime-reported gpt-6.1-sol selection is not provider revision, immutable model identity, cost, or a repeated-sample claim; missing provider-returned identity, revision, seed and cost stay null.

approval_revision.approval_source: User-approved via ask on 2026-10-23; no execution receipt
approval_revision.operational_guard_boundary: The pooled ceiling does not populate per-run budget, token, wall-time, repair, tool-call, operator-intervention or price guards; those remain null until separately approved.
approval_revision.launch_boundary: No blanket claim that all launch gates pass or that the 72-assignment-per-track grid is funded. No new study has executed.

staged_plan.name: credential-free replay, observer, rubric and adapter preflight
staged_plan.objective: Establish that the evidence, observer inventory, acceptance rubric and adapters can be checked without credentials, provider calls, paid spend, deployment or model generation.
actions: Replay only preserved, immutable receipts from the prior case and verify their hashes, event ordering, status semantics and read-only boundary; do not treat replay as a new run.

Freeze an arm-neutral observer inventory before any coding assignment, including prompt/evidence receipt, workspace/thread, starting checkout, identity, tool calls, file diffs, commands, stdout/stderr/exit/elapsed, repair boundaries, reruns, acceptance checks, save/load hashes, replay hashes, operator intervention and stop reason.
Dry-validate the bilingual rubric and its rule-to-check bindings on fixtures, including missing, N/A, failure, timeout, not-reached and safety-stop states; no model call is needed.
Check adapter capability declarations against existing local runner evidence. Unknown new runners remain IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED rather than being represented as working.
Record a preflight receipt with pass/fail/indeterminate per item; any incomplete inventory is coverage INDETERMINATE, never a complete percentage.
staged_plan.exit_gate: All required schemas parse, preserved replay is read-only, observer fields have owners, rubric fixtures preserve fail-closed semantics, and no credential/provider/paid boundary is crossed.

staged_plan.name: shared-tool-interface feasibility
staged_plan.objective: Determine whether the candidate systems can perform the same coding task through a common observable tool interface.
actions: Verify native Codex runtime selection as runtime-reported gpt-6.1-sol only when an actual native turn receipt reports that value; leave provider-returned model, immutable revision, seed and cost null when unavailable.
Discover and verify an exact Claude model identity from the actual authorized runtime before freezing the study; never invent a model ID or infer availability from a UI label.

Test Gemini App Argon for actual file-edit, command/build, readback and observer capabilities. UI consultation alone is not a coding comparison. Preserve the product/model naming exactly; never relabel Pro or Flash as Argon.

If equal coding/tool/observer parity is unavailable, select SPLIT_STACK_COMPARISON (with the difference disclosed and no pooled coding endpoint) or BLOCK_ARGON_CODING_ARM. Do not silently substitute a fallback model/system.
Freeze capability results and missingness before any whole-game assignment.
staged_plan.exit_gate: At least two systems have verified, comparable coding/tool/observer capabilities for a coding comparison, or the protocol explicitly records split-stack/blocking and excludes the unavailable coding arm.

staged_plan.name: fresh whole-game microgame assignments
staged_plan.objective: Run a fresh-workspace, fresh-thread, self-contained Godot microgame task with a frozen complete acceptance suite.
actions: Create each assignment from the same frozen checkout/brief/assets/evidence receipt; start a fresh workspace and fresh thread. Resume is never an independent repeat.
Use only licensed or procedural assets with a recorded license/provenance receipt; no unapproved downloads or paid generation.
Require every acceptance check in the frozen suite: scenes, movement, game goal, ontology gate, repair, replay, read-only signals, save/load, build and deterministic QA.
Preserve unfinished, failed, timeout and safety-stop assignments as not completed. Stop time is never a success time.
Collect raw observer receipts and independently exercised acceptance evidence before adjudication.
staged_plan.exit_gate: A run is complete only when every applicable acceptance check has an independently verified PASS and the observer inventory is complete; otherwise it remains incomplete/failed/indeterminate with its reason.

staged_plan.name: matched-information factorial blocks
staged_plan.objective: Compare general-rule and ontology representations by model/system and independent task-run blocks without confounding representation, order or resumed state.
actions: Give every arm the same complete game brief, starting checkout, assets, tool permissions, acceptance suite, rule facts and observer requirements. Change only the frozen representation encoding: general-rule versus ontology representation.
Randomize or counterbalance representation and system order using a frozen seed recorded before launch; do not use convenience order.
Treat each fresh workspace/thread/task execution as an independent run. A repair retry inside one run is an attempt, not a repeat.
Keep arm-level quality, time and traceability outputs separate; do not combine them into a composite score or presume ontology/model superiority.
Account for task-block clustering and matched pairs in analysis; report per-cell data before any paired or clustered summary.
staged_plan.exit_gate: All assigned cells have a declared denominator and order assignment, and every launched run has a complete status record even when blocked, failed or timed out.

staged_plan.name: feasibility pilot, then larger repetition and held-out task study
staged_plan.objective: Use an explicitly exploratory pilot to test operational feasibility, then decide whether a larger repeated and held-out study is justified.
actions: Run only the approved exploratory pilot matrix below; it is not powered or confirmatory and produces no sample-size benefit claim.
Assess adapter parity, observer completeness, frozen-acceptance executability, missingness, repair-boundary capture, timing capture, and deterministic replay before expanding.
If the feasibility gate passes, freeze a larger repetition count and held-out task set before any larger run. Held-out tasks are not used to tune the pilot rubric or representation.
If the gate fails, report the concrete blocker and stop the affected arm/study; do not repair the evidence by dropping failed or unavailable assignments.
staged_plan.exit_gate: Expansion is allowed only after an approved decision records feasibility evidence, caps, task holdout, and analysis denominators; otherwise the pilot remains exploratory and no superiority/efficacy claim is made.

systems.identity_requirement: Native runtime receipt must report gpt-6.1-sol; requested, runtime-reported, provider-returned and immutable revision are separate fields.
systems.no_inference_rule: A model self-report or requested name does not establish provider identity or a new run.

systems.identity_requirement: Exact model identifier must be discovered from and verified by the authorized runtime before protocol freeze.
systems.no_inference_rule: Do not invent an ID or treat documentation/UI text as an executed coding capability.

systems.identity_requirement: Argon must return an actual coding/tool/observer receipt; UI consultation is not a coding run.
systems.naming_rule: Never rename Pro or Flash as Argon and never substitute another Gemini model.
systems.consultation_ui_note: The requested account showed a '4 Argon complex tasks' option and Argon was selected; no response or coding-tool parity was established. This is consultation UI availability only.
systems.fallback_policy: If not tool-capable or not independently observable, block the Argon coding arm or disclose a non-pooled split-stack comparison.

shared_interface.runner_contract_status: Only existing actual runners may be named as working; an unknown new model runner is an implementation task.

microgame_task_contract.freshness: fresh workspace and fresh thread per assignment; no resume-as-repeat
microgame_task_contract.brief: Build a self-contained Godot microgame from the frozen checkout, using a small playable world and the supplied complete rules/evidence. The player must traverse scenes, move, achieve a declared goal, encounter an ontology-governed action, observe a repair/replay trace, save/load state, and pass deterministic QA.
microgame_task_contract.matched_information: General-rule and ontology representations contain the same facts, policies, examples, allowed tools, assets and complete acceptance suite; representation syntax is the only planned information factor.
microgame_task_contract.asset_policy: Licensed or procedural assets only; provenance and license receipt are required. No unapproved downloads, paid generation or provider fallback.

acceptance_suite.requirement: At least two named scenes load from a clean checkout and transition through the declared route without hidden manual setup.
Declared player movement/input works deterministically under the allowed input fixture and does not mutate frozen evidence.
The declared goal has a reproducible success condition and a visible/readable completion receipt.
The declared ontology/policy gate denies an unauthorized action and allows the authorized action using the frozen rule identifiers.
A bounded repair attempt records the original candidate, error, change and rerun; failed repairs remain traceable and do not silently commit.
A clean replay from the same receipt reproduces the declared decision, acceptance status and relevant state/hash outputs.
Observer/dashboard signals expose declared versus observed state and missing/unreported evidence without mutating game state or frozen inputs.
Save/load preserves the declared canonical state, version/hash and goal-relevant facts, with a receipt proving the round trip.
The approved existing build path, or a separately approved new runner, produces a runnable artifact from a clean checkout; unknown runner paths are not claimed as working.
Repeated deterministic QA on isolated copies produces the same declared outcomes and detects seeded valid corruptions without accepting false clean results.

task_blocks.pilot_role: reserved; not used in pilot tuning

task_blocks.label: held-out task block 2

microgame_task_contract.acceptance_scope_rule: The two pilot task blocks and later held-out blocks must each instantiate all ten acceptance IDs; labels do not relax the suite.

formula.planned_cell_count: R * S * T where R=2 representations, S=number of systems passing S2, T=2 pilot task blocks
formula.assigned_run_count: N_assigned = R * S * T * I, where I=2 fresh independent repeats per cell; blocked systems retain planned cells but have N_launched=0 and are not silently removed
formula.interpretation: These counts are assignment plans, not observed results, power calculations, or sample-size benefits.

candidate_pilot_matrix.order_rule: Use a frozen randomization/counterbalance seed and record representation/system/task order before launch; no convenience ordering and no resumed run as an independent repeat.

primary_endpoint.name: time_to_first_all_predeclared_validation_pass
primary_endpoint.start: timestamp when the complete frozen brief and evidence receipt is delivered to the fresh run
primary_endpoint.stop: timestamp when the last applicable acceptance check first independently verifies PASS
primary_endpoint.rule: Stop time for an unfinished or failed run is never a success time.

secondary_outputs.time: Per-run primary endpoint plus censoring/stop reason; do not replace missing success time with a cap.

traceability.per_dimension_formula: n_d = applicable units with ALL predeclared links independently verified; N_d = ALL applicable opportunities in the complete arm-neutral observer inventory; report n_d/N_d and per-link counts separately.
traceability.missing_rule: A missing required link is 0, not PASS.
traceability.inventory_rule: If the observer inventory is incomplete, the dimension is coverage INDETERMINATE, not a complete percentage.
traceability.repair_na_rule: Repair is N/A only when an actual zero repairs is independently verified; a failed repair may still be fully traceable.

assigned_denominators.N_planned_cells: all representation x system x task-block cells declared before launch, including conditionally blocked cells
assigned_denominators.N_assigned: sum of assigned fresh independent runs across all declared cells
assigned_denominators.N_launched: assigned runs that crossed the launch receipt boundary
assigned_denominators.N_completed: launched runs with every applicable acceptance check resolved and complete observer inventory
assigned_denominators.N_all_acceptance: per acceptance ID, all applicable launched runs; report pass/fail/not-reached separately
assigned_denominators.N_all_pass: runs where every applicable acceptance ID independently verified PASS
assigned_denominators.N_failed: launched runs with a failed acceptance or failed safety/validity check
assigned_denominators.N_timeout: launched runs stopped at a frozen time cap without first all-pass
assigned_denominators.N_blocked_unavailable: planned cells not launched because model/tool/consent/capability prerequisite was absent
assigned_denominators.N_missing_evidence: launched runs whose required observer evidence is absent; retain in denominator and mark invalid/indeterminate
assigned_denominators.N_d: all applicable observer opportunities for traceability dimension d, not only successful runs
assigned_denominators.N_link: per-link opportunity denominator inside each N_d; retain link type and missingness
assigned_denominators.cluster_key: task_block_id paired within representation/system when both arms exist; repeated fresh runs are nested in task blocks, not independent task-level populations

endpoints_and_denominators.analysis_rule: Report descriptive per-cell distributions first, then paired/clustered analyses that respect task-block nesting and repeated fresh runs. Do not pool blocked systems, invent denominators, or claim significance/superiority from the pilot.

observer_inventory.independence_rule: The author/runner does not silently author the independent acceptance result; two blinded-as-feasible coders lock raw ratings before adjudication for traceability dimensions.
observer_inventory.expected_detection: Record detected valid corruptions, seeded valid corruptions and false alarms separately; format-only/irrelevant decorative changes should not alter grades.

canonical_rubric_reference.rule: This cross-reference is planned, not validated or executed; no rubric score is implied.

caps_and_approval.budget_usd_meaning: Per-run operational budget; null and not supplied by the aggregate ceiling.
caps_and_approval.rule: The USD 100 pooled ceiling is planning authorization only. Null or missing operational cap/launch approval fails the launch gate; do not infer consent, provider availability, pricing, or funding for the 72-assignment grid.

pickup_steps: Read this protocol and the two bilingual plans; confirm status remains PROPOSED_NOT_EXECUTED.
Read only the public current contract/result and interview note named in the plans; preserve immutable raw/archives/frozen results and do not read private intake.
Implement or locate the credential-free S1 replay/observer/rubric/adaptor preflight; produce a receipt without provider calls.

Run S2 capability discovery. Fill exact Claude model identity only from a verified runtime receipt; decide whether Argon is tool-capable. If not, mark BLOCKED_ARGON_CODING_ARM or SPLIT_STACK_COMPARISON.
Freeze the complete microgame brief, task blocks, representation encodings, assets/licenses, acceptance IDs, randomization seed, observer schema and all caps/approvals.
Implement the unknown microgame runner only if approved; name its exact argv/config after it exists and is verified. Do not use the prior dashboard runner as a proxy.
Launch the exploratory pilot matrix with fresh workspaces/threads and independent repeats; preserve every assigned denominator and stop reason.
Have two independent coders lock raw traceability/acceptance ratings before adjudication; run replay mutation and clean-control checks.
Issue a feasibility decision. Only then freeze any larger repetition and held-out task study; otherwise stop with the concrete blocker and no comparative claim.
Ingest all nine exact candidate labels without alias normalization; canonical_id remains null until the verified registry confirms it.
Freeze separate B1/B2 coding and C1/C2 content task banks plus H1/H2/HC1/HC2 held-out blocks, schema/hard-validity rules, novelty controls and independent grader access.
Implement and preflight separate whole-game coding and ontology-content runners; both remain IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED until exact argv/config receipts exist.
Do not launch either track until common information/tool/compute/clock/budget parity, non-null approvals/caps and the fail-closed checklist pass.

expanded_candidate_cohort.canonical_id_policy: Preserve each exact user label. canonical_id stays null in this protocol until the Main-owned verified candidate evidence registry confirms it; public catalog labels, runtime availability, provider-returned identity and backend revision remain separate fields.
expanded_candidate_cohort.no_execution_statement: No candidate in this expanded cohort has been called, built, deployed or used to generate a result.

candidates.fallback_risk: Documented auto-fallback risk; require runtime/provider-returned identity for the requested candidate before launch.

planned_registry_refs.source_of_truth: model-registry.json identity evidence; protocol candidate labels remain the prospective contract
planned_registry_refs.duplicate_identity_rule: Do not join or merge by display name; do not duplicate identity claims across registry, panels and protocol.
planned_registry_refs.s1_boundary: Registry/panel records and S1 preflight evidence are readiness evidence, not study results and do not imply a launched run.

expanded_candidate_cohort.identity_boundary: Read-only identity agents may supply candidate evidence to the Main-owned registry. No label, official card, UI option or runtime version proves account access, provider-returned identity, immutable revision, spend, coding parity or content-generation parity.

whole_game_coding.candidate_eligibility: Each candidate requires its own read-only capability/adaptor receipt; no candidate is presumed runnable.

ontology_content_generation.matched_input: Each representation receives the same frozen facts, rules, examples, task brief, tool permissions, compute, clock and start checkout; only general-rule versus ontology representation changes.
hard_validity_checks: deterministic replay and read-only evidence binding

repair_budget.rule: Every repair attempt, boundary, change, rerun and result is recorded; failed repair remains a result and cannot silently pass.

ontology_content_generation.quality_novelty_policy: Novelty and quality are separate exploratory outputs from hard validity. Freeze a novelty definition, duplicate/near-duplicate controls, blind grading instructions and quality rubric before launch. No quality or novelty score can override a hard-validity failure, and no composite score is formed.
ontology_content_generation.grader_policy: Use independent human or neutral graders with locked raw ratings before adjudication. Jev may be advisory but is not the gold label, independent human truth or commit authority.

minimal_feasibility_schedule.budget_interpretation: Shared planning ceiling only; does not fund or authorize all scheduled assignments and does not replace per-run guards.

stages.purpose: Credential-free S1 replay/observer/rubric/adaptor preflight for every candidate and track; no provider call.
After identity/tool capability and operational guards are receipt-backed, one fresh B1 coding and one fresh C1 content assignment per verified candidate using general_rule only.
Only for F1 cells passing hard launch/observer checks, one fresh matched ontology_representation assignment per candidate and track.

minimal_feasibility_schedule.interpretation: Descriptive feasibility schedule only; not powered or confirmatory. Failures, blocks and missing evidence retain denominators and stop reasons. The full 72-per-track matrix remains separately proposed, unfunded and not assumed executable.
minimal_feasibility_schedule.no_execution_statement: No F0, F1 or F2 assignment has started.

expanded_candidate_matrix.label: EXPLORATORY_NOT_POWERED_CONFIRMATORY
expanded_candidate_matrix.formula: N_planned_per_track = 9 candidates * 2 representations * 2 task blocks * 2 fresh independent repeats = 72

legacy_subset_examples.scope: Old subset examples only; do not call them the full nine-candidate cohort.

expanded_candidate_matrix.interpretation: 72 is planned only per track. No candidate is launched, no run is counted, and no sample-power or benefit claim follows. The pooled USD 100 ceiling is not evidence that 72 calls are funded. Blocked/unavailable cells retain planned denominators and have N_launched=0.

cross_track_controls.exact_task_bank: Freeze C1/C2 and B1/B2 prompts, facts, rules, examples, expected outputs, acceptance IDs and held-out HC1/HC2/H1/H2 before any candidate run; no post hoc task substitution.
cross_track_controls.information_equivalence: Representations must carry identical semantic information, tool permissions, compute environment, clock source, start checkout and asset/license packet; syntax is the planned factor.
cross_track_controls.tool_budget_parity: Use the same allowed tool surface and frozen per-run budget/token/wall-time/repair/intervention/price guards across matched cells; all operational cap values remain null until separately approved. The pooled USD 100 ceiling is shared across tracks and does not replace these guards.
cross_track_controls.grader_independence: Human/neutral graders are independent of candidate authors/runners, lock raw ratings before adjudication, and do not use Jev as gold.
cross_track_controls.clustering: Cluster or pair by task block within each track; fresh repeats are nested runs, not independent task populations.
cross_track_controls.censoring: Keep unfinished/failure/timeout/safety-stop/blocked/missing evidence as non-success statuses; never replace a missing time-to-pass with stop time or cap.
cross_track_controls.multiplicity: Freeze the confirmatory contrasts, family structure and multiplicity procedure before any larger study; pilot outputs remain descriptive and exploratory.
cross_track_controls.held_out: Do not tune prompts, representations, rubric, novelty metric or repairs on HC1/HC2/H1/H2; report held-out results separately.
cross_track_controls.novelty_controls: Predeclare novelty unit, duplicate/near-duplicate baseline, seed/control cases, grader blinding and false-alarm handling; report novelty separately from hard validity and quality.

new_runner_gaps.rule: Only an existing, credential-free, observed runner may be named as working. Unknown runner work is an implementation task and cannot be represented as a completed capability.
